steps.what: Define weather training objectives, audience needs, verified examples and limits of the content
Develop draft weather training materials from the selected objectives and verified examples

loop.purpose: Draft explanations and exercises for a defined audience
loop.input: Checked objectives, example sources and content restrictions
loop.output: Draft explanations and exercises with source references
loop.check: Scientist checks weather accuracy, audience suitability and whether examples support each explanation
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported statements return to manual preparation
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates organise materials but cannot phrase varied explanations and exercises

steps.what: Check materials and deliver weather training with discussion and answers to participant questions

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} training templates and existing examples before adding a bounded prose draft. The scientist checks materials and delivers the session; participant interaction and explanation retain full time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Audience-specific explanations and exercises require preparation after objectives are chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can express selected scientific material for a defined audience.
tasks.still_hard: Explain uncertainty and correct misconceptions during training.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt the session to participant reasoning and questions.
tasks.altitude: Reduce limited first-draft preparation while protecting scientific teaching.

evidence.claim: Bounded drafting can assist weather training preparation; the exact design and savings are model knowledge.

assumptions: In s1 the scientist captures audience, learning objectives, duration, source examples, exact scientific points and prohibited extrapolations; its 25 hours includes all brief preparation.
The 17.5 remaining hours in s2 include scientific checking and repair; s3 retains final material checks and live delivery.
Use native templates and existing teaching resources first; four extra focal hours cover draft and example upkeep.
No weather warning or public safety instruction is generated without the scientist's content decisions.
Unsupported sources return to manual preparation; no reduction is claimed in discussion time.
research_questions: Does drafting save preparation time after brief capture and scientific repair?

approvals.approved_version: Exact rendered materials, source examples, intended audience and scientific limitations; changed content voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=92.5; gross 7.5 minus 4 focal upkeep gives central net 3.5. E1 range 0-2 allows reused materials and repair-heavy drafts; delivery remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare scientific atmospheric and climate reports or articles

steps.what: Select atmospheric or climate findings, figures and source references for scientific reports
Prepare draft scientific atmospheric or climate text with linked evidence and explicit uncertainties

loop.purpose: Express selected findings in coherent scientific sections
loop.input: Checked claims, figures, source references and document outline
loop.output: Draft sections with traceable claims and missing-evidence markers
loop.check: Scientist checks each figure, citation and causal statement against the original source and intended meaning
loop.stop: One revision; any unsupported claim or unverifiable reference returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates place figures but cannot compose varied scientific argumentation

steps.what: Review scientific reports, articles or texts for sound interpretation and complete source traceability

tasks.design: Populate fixed tables and headings in {DOCS} from checked {DATA_PLATFORM} outputs, then use bounded drafting for selected narrative sections. Keep interpretation and manuscript review with the scientist; publication and public release remain separate actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Checked scientific findings still require coherent report and article prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates and bounded drafting can reuse a source packet without inventing findings.
tasks.still_hard: Explain uncertainty and avoid claims stronger than the evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Own scientific reasoning and the integrity of references.
tasks.altitude: Reduce initial prose work while preserving scientific authorship.

evidence.claim: The digest reports fabricated references in generated literature reviews; citations require source verification rather than trust in generated text.
The bounded writing design and proposed time effect are unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: In s1 the scientist produces exact findings, dataset versions, figure files, units, uncertainty statements, permitted claims, source references and outline; its 35 hours includes capture and validation.
Research analysis and forecast decisions are already completed in their own tasks; this task receives no duplicate analysis saving.
The 24 remaining hours in s2 include citation, number and wording repairs; s3 retains complete scientific review.
Use native report templates first; six extra focal hours cover source access, prompt changes and regression checks.
Missing evidence returns to manual writing; the assistant cannot invent citations or publish a manuscript.
research_questions: Does source-grounded drafting save time after packet preparation, citation verification and author review?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=84; gross 16 minus 6 focal upkeep gives central net 10. E1 range 0-5 allows difficult scientific prose and extensive source repair; analysis and publication receive no credit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze climate datasets with physical and numerical methods

steps.what: Analyze climate data sets using geophysical flow analysis, data assimilation or numerical modeling

tasks.design: Retain physical method selection, numerical analysis checks and interpretation using {DATA_PLATFORM} and {DOCS}. Existing solver execution is already computational work and provides no new labour saving by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Numerically successful analysis may still rest on invalid assumptions or unsuitable data.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing numerical and assimilation systems support scientific analysis.
tasks.still_hard: Choose valid methods and recognise numerical or physical artefacts.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the calculation answers the scientific question.

reach.task: Evaluate numerical stability and model assumptions

evidence.claim: Specialist climate analysis retains scientific judgement; existing numerical execution establishes no new human time saving.

assumptions: The baseline contains scientific method selection and analysis checks, excluding unattended compute runtime.
Repeatable data preparation counted in the broader research task is not counted again here.
No new service or added upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Is repeated analyst setup measurable separately from existing solver execution and research preparation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Physical and numerical analysis judgement remains; existing compute execution earns no credit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze historical climate records for future weather and climate trends

steps.what: Validate historical precipitation and temperature records, station changes and selected trend-analysis rules
Calculate specified historical climate summaries, trend estimates and diagnostic plots
Analyze historical climate information and assess what trends support future predictions

tasks.design: Use native statistical functions in {DATA_PLATFORM} or controlled {SPREADSHEET} calculations before adding a small repeatable pipeline. Retain record homogeneity, method selection and predictive interpretation with the scientist; a trend estimate is not a forecast.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated aggregation and plotting follow substantial historical-record checking.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit statistical operations can be rerun over checked records.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise station changes, missingness and limits of extrapolation.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish apparent historical trends from defensible predictive evidence.
tasks.altitude: Make historical statistics reproducible without automating prediction judgement.

reach.task: Resolve station metadata and record revisions

evidence.claim: Deterministic climate summaries and selected trend calculations can be repeated from checked records; the exact design and savings are model knowledge.

assumptions: Data curators produce station IDs, dates, units, observed values, station-change metadata and source versions; two added other-role hours cover metadata corrections.

In s1 the scientist captures and checks those fields, time window, missingness rules, station inclusion, transformations and selected trend method; its 35 hours includes source reconciliation and all focal specification capture.
Unresolved station changes or missing metadata return to manual investigation in s1 and interpretation in s3; no automatic homogeneity flag is assumed.
Eight extra focal hours cover method, metadata and regression upkeep; existing scripts can reduce savings to zero.
This narrower historical-statistics task owns its calculations; the broader research-preparation task must exclude these same minutes during role roll-up.
research_questions: Do repeated summaries save time after historical-record checks and method maintenance?

already_counted.description: Historical data and method specification capture

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross 25 minus 8 focal upkeep gives central net 17. E1 range 0-8 allows existing scripts and difficult station histories; predictive interpretation remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated statistics and first drafts while retaining atmospheric reasoning and public explanation.
reach: Resolve historical records with climate curators
role.ambitious_version: An atmospheric scientist who uses traceable preparation and drafts while retaining responsibility for physical analysis, predictions and teaching.
